qemu_command: qemu-system-aarch64 -M virt -cpu cortex-a53 -smp 4 -m 512M -icount shift=3,sleep=off -kernel /images/Image -append root=/dev/vda rw rootwait console=ttyAMA0 -drive file=/state/rootfs.ext4,if=none,format=raw,id=hd0 -device virtio-blk-device,drive=hd0 -netdev user,id=eth0,hostfwd=tcp:127.0.0.1:2222-:22 -device virtio-net-device,netdev=eth0 -fw_cfg name=opt/cc1/authorized_keys,file=/secrets/id_ed25519.pub -display none -serial file:/state/console.log -monitor unix:/state/monitor.sock,server,nowait
